title: No Cookie, No Passage
description: The refresh endpoint reads the rotation token from an httpOnly cookie, never from the request body. Confirm a caller who tries to skip the cookie and just claim a refresh token in JSON gets nowhere.
successCondition: POST /api/auth/refresh with no th_refresh cookie set, but with a body of { "refreshToken": "<a real, valid refresh token obtained from a prior login" }, returns 401 with error.code UNAUTHORIZED — the body's refreshToken field is never read.
hints: You'll need to log in first via POST /api/auth/login to obtain a genuine refresh token to place in the body, so the test proves the body is ignored rather than the token being invalid.
Send the refresh request with cookies stripped explicitly (most HTTP clients auto-attach cookies from the same session by default) — verify your tool isn't silently reattaching it.
